proof_roadmap: Choose resolutions of the two modules and express both sides as homology of total complexes (proof lines 15049-15070).
Replace the derived tensor products by ordinary ones using flatness (proof lines 15070-15085).

difficulty_reason: The lemma compares two ways of expressing Tor independence for modules over a flat algebra, and its proof is a 51-line computation with a single external pointer. It writes both sides of the comparison as the homology of explicit complexes obtained by resolving the two modules, uses the flatness of the algebra to replace the derived tensor products by ordinary total complexes, and then identifies the two complexes by reordering the tensor factors. The identification is displayed in the source and each step is justified by either associativity of the tensor product or flatness.
